patch_description: The current ANSATZ_SPEC (single nearest-neighbor CRZ ring + CZ gates) underperforms the previously best-scoring "dual-ring shared" variant (score 0.91) that added a next-nearest-neighbor (distance-2) CRZ ring with only 2 extra shared parameters, plus finer-grained 4-way parameter sharing on the RY/RZ pre/post rotation layers instead of 2-way (lo/hi) sharing. Replacing the current weaker ansatz with this proven dual-ring structure should recover the higher validation/test accuracy, lower loss, and smaller generalization gap observed previously, while keeping parameter count moderate (98 total params vs 80 currently, still well within budget). This directly incorporates the best-known ansatz architecture from prior evolution history back into the current program, since the present candidate regressed to a weaker single-ring design.
